subject: t-c-imp
title: T.C.IMP.------RT.DY.
description: Diagram opening R(AS)CM(II)-41 — the section identifying the middle-sixties as the primary time-junction that dictated how alternative-recording's spread could be utilized (Strata East, Jazz Composer's Orchestra). The prose below identifies the structural target: 'the middle sixties as a primary time junction that dictated how the spread of alternative recording could be utilized and made successful.' The crossing diagrams how time-continuum-implications structurally meets reality-dynamics at the alternative-recording time-junction scale: T-C-IMP (time continuum implications) crossed with RT-DY (reality dynamics — the actual reality-dynamics conditions an alternative-recording effort must meet). T-C-IMP sits on the left with the subject-arrow, and its main line runs down-right to RT-DY. Three lines leave the main line: one rises up-right to EXP-DY (expansion dynamics), with PER-TR (perceived transformation) and CULT-AF-B (culture affinity basis) branching from it and INFO-DY (information dynamics) branching in turn from CULT-AF-B; one runs down-left to PROG-CONT (progressional continuance), with TRS (transition) branching from it; and a vertical drops to POL-P (political policies), with MOT-DY branching from it and AFTD (affinity tendencies) branching in turn from MOT-DY.
